name: MCP Local LLM Server
description: A privacy-first MCP server that provides local LLM-enhanced tools for code analysis, security scanning, and automated task execution using backends like Ollama and LM Studio. It enables symbol-aware code reviews and workspace exploration while ensuring that all code and analysis remain strictly on your local machine.
